text:
Maya: Quick design review: export affordances in the Error Session panel. dropping mockups + notes.
Oliver: link?
Maya: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/error-export (mockup v3)
Priya: TL;DR from PM: 1) Make "Copy correlation ID" more discoverable, 2) deterministic filenames, 3) don't break screenreader/keyboard when modal appears.
Samir: Filename proposal: `error-<corrid>-<short-ts>.json` — easy to index. ok?
Maya: Works. Also thinking microcopy: "Export session — includes stack, request/response, logs" — maybe too long in tight header.
Oliver: Shorten to "Includes stack, request/response, logs". Also question: should Export be primary? current mock makes it primary and it's visually noisy.
Priya: Product prefers Export as secondary (top-right). Primary reserved for "Open in Request Explorer" or "Acknowledge". Export as dropdown: JSON, HAR, CSV.
Maya: Dropdown + small caret then. And add small "Open raw JSON" item that opens in new tab (no download) for quick inspection.
Samir: For copy corrID, put a tiny copy icon next to the correlation pill with aria-label "Copy correlation id to clipboard" and make it keyboard-focusable.
Oliver: Keyboard/aria details: open dropdown with Enter/Space, arrow between items, Enter to trigger download, Escape to close. When download starts announce progress.
Maya: Progress UX: ephemeral toast "Preparing export…" then "Download ready" with a 2s focusable link. Is that sr-friendly?
Samir: Toasts need careful roles: use role=status for progress updates and role=alert when ready. Avoid forcing focus unless action required.
Priya: Compliance: if session contains PII markers (email, ssn, ip) show a confirmation modal with checkbox "I confirm this export may contain sensitive data" + "Read our export policy" link.
Maya: Modal copy: title "Export session"; body "This session may contain user data. Select formats and confirm to download." CTA label: "Download" (product asked for explicit verb).
Oliver: Modal accessibility: role=dialog, aria-labelledby, trap focus, Escape closes, visible Cancel. Screenreader should announce modal title.
Samir: Telemetry: emit `export_session` with fields: format, size_estimate, pii_flag, user_role. Backend returns presigned URL and optional size estimate.
Maya: Microcopy for format menu: JSON -> "Full session (JSON)", HAR -> "Network trace (HAR)", CSV -> "Compact table (CSV)". If nested payloads, disable CSV with tooltip "Not available for sessions with nested payloads".
Priya: Filenames: deterministic and copyable. Example: `redwood-error-<corrid>-<YYYYMMDD>-<hhmm>.json` — we'll keep the short-ts variant for space.
Oliver: Edge case: very large HARs. Show size estimate before starting and warn "Large download may take time".
Maya: Accessibility checklist for handoff:
- Export dropdown keyboard interactions
- Copy CorrID button aria-label + live region confirmation
- Modal: role=dialog, aria-labelledby, trap focus, Escape to close
- Progress: role=status updates -> role=alert when done
- Filenames deterministic and copyable
- Telemetry events emitted
Samir: I'll add e2e tests for keyboard nav and live region announcements.
Priya: I'll confirm legal copy and consent checkbox text tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
Maya: I'll push mock updates and attach code snippets in PR. ConsoleBot: uploaded export-flow-v3.png
ConsoleBot: uploaded export-flow-v3.png
Oliver: One more ask: can the dropdown include a small inline explanation under each format (secondary text) for clarity? keeps discoverability high.
Maya: yes, add sublabel under menu items in mock.
Priya: Creating follow-up ticket UX-EXPORT-112 with ACs.
Maya: leaving thread. ping if anything else.
